title: Source vault parent directory has a trailing space in its name
observed: The directory containing both source vaults is named 'AI ' (with trailing space). Path handling that strips or normalizes whitespace can silently misresolve; shell commands require quoting.
expected_condition: Source roots recorded exactly as-is and always quoted; consider an explicit path alias in state if tooling needs a stable name.
repair_recommendation: Do not rename (source immutability). Record exact paths in state/current-state.json and source location records; all framework operations must pass the literal path.
evidence: ls -la source-vaults/ shows directory 'AI ' with trailing space; inventory commands run with quoted paths succeeded.

title: 14 AI Course notes have unclosed code fences or math blocks
affected_source: source-vaults/AI /AI Course (14 files listed in reports/framework/boot-000-smoke-check-links-ai-course.json, problem type parse_error)
observed: check-links on the AI Course vault reports 14 files with parse errors (unclosed code fences, e.g. '03. The Four Pillars of Data Science.md' ends inside an unterminated mermaid fence at line 30). Verified against raw source: the fence is genuinely unclosed in the source file.
expected_condition: Extraction (BOOT-002+) must treat content inside unclosed fences as real content with an explicit parser-error disposition; it must not be silently dropped.
repair_recommendation: During extraction, record unclosed-fence content as-is with a parse warning; flag affected notes for synthesis review.
evidence: vu check-links --root 'source-vaults/AI /AI Course' -> problem_counts.parse_error = 14; manual tail inspection confirms unterminated fence. | BOOT-002 cross-validation: the 14 files exactly match the 14 error files independently reported by the new vu stats capability (reports/bootstrap/boot-002-stats-ai-course.json), confirming the defect set via two independent code paths.

title: AI Course vault contains 175 broken wikilinks including folder-name targets

Weight Initialization' (6), '08.3 - Vision Transformers' (5). These may be intentional folder-level links or links to notes that were never created/renamed. Also 10 missing anchors.
expected_condition: During synthesis, each broken link needs a disposition: intentional folder reference, renamed target, or genuinely dangling link.
repair_recommendation: Defer to synthesis-time provenance review; keep the full list in the smoke report as baseline evidence.

title: README repository-status section contradicted actual repository contents
observed: README.md 'Repository status' claimed the repository 'does not contain the two source vaults'. Repository evidence shows both vaults committed under source-vaults/AI / in the root commit b7f58fe72604554754355e25e5caf8c153abe276 (verified during BOOT-001 startup: 333 + 276 markdown files, manifests match).
expected_condition: Documentation must match verified repository evidence; a fresh agent relying on the stale claim could conclude sources are missing elsewhere.
repair_recommendation: Correct the README status section to state that both immutable source vaults live in the repository and point to the BOOT-001 location record.
evidence: git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD -> b7f58fe...; reports/bootstrap/boot-001-source-location.json; README diff in the BOOT-001 commit.
resolution: README.md repository-status section rewritten in the BOOT-001 commit to reflect verified state; discrepancy recorded per docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md validation rule.

title: BOOT-004 handoff and task record stated 7 files for the AI Course 03.1 Regression scope; actual count is 6
observed: The BOOT-004 handoff suggested 'AI Course 03.1 - Regression, 7 files' and the EXT-001 task record echoed '7 files'. Repository evidence: the directory contains exactly 6 markdown files (01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 07 - numbering skips 06) and state/manifests/ai-course.jsonl holds exactly 6 records with the '03 - Machine Learning/03.1 - Regression/' prefix.
expected_condition: Handoff counts and denominators must be derived from repository evidence (manifests, inventory), not estimated; a fresh session that trusted the handoff could hunt for a missing 7th file or report a coverage gap.
repair_recommendation: Use the manifest as the denominator authority (done in EXT-001: denominator 6, 6/6 extracted). Handoffs should quote counts with their source (manifest path + record count).
evidence: ls and rg on 'source-vaults/AI /AI Course/03 - Machine Learning/03.1 - Regression/' show 6 .md files; rg '03.1 - Regression' state/manifests/ai-course.jsonl matches 6 records (lines 56-61); reports/extraction/ext001-coverage.json denominators.files_in_scope = 6.
resolution: EXT-001 extracted against the actual 6-file scope; task record corrected; this finding records the discrepancy so handoff claims remain verifiable.

title: Naive substring term matching produces false positives that would corrupt cross-vault overlap classification (EXT-003+)
affected_paths: any term-based overlap or frequency tooling
observed: EXT-002-REVIEW confirmed: substring search for 'ridge' matches 'b' + 'ridge' in AI Course text (English word 'bridge'), and searches for 'L1'/'L2' match mermaid diagram node labels like 'L1[...]'/'L2[...]' in the AI Course regression batch. A naive grep-based candidate discovery would therefore report spurious ridge/lasso coverage in the AI Course vault (the review verified the course batch contains ZERO genuine ridge/lasso/regularization content).
expected_condition: Overlap candidate discovery (CAP-013) and any term-frequency tooling must use word-boundary-aware matching (with alias lists) AND excerpt-level human/LLM confirmation before recording any overlap classification; substring counts must never be presented as semantic evidence.
repair_recommendation: Implement CAP-013 with word-boundary regex matching + alias support + excerpt-context capture; add regression tests using the exact false-positive cases ('bridge' vs 'ridge', mermaid 'L1['/'L2[' nodes, code-fence interiors excluded or flagged separately).
discovered_by: EXT-002-REVIEW (independent review subagent), confirmed by orchestrator
